Tomas B.: Hi folks 2
8 Ib4m caring for my niece under a temporary guardianship (court emergency order). Can I add her to my medical/dental as a dependent while the guardianship is in effect?
Lina (People Ops): Sorry you're in this situation, Tomas. Yes, temporary guardianship is a QLE if you became the childs primary caregiver. We need documentation.
Tomas B.: What documents exactly? The court order is labelled "emergency temporary guardianship" and it's stamped, but I don't have anything else yet.
Evie R.: Primary doc = court order or state guardianship paperwork. If the order is temporary/emergency we usually ask for a secondary doc showing residence (school record, DMV address change, or a signed attestation from the placing agency).
Tomas B.: I can get the school enrollment form and a signed letter from the agency that placed the child. Will that count?
Lina (People Ops): Yes: upload the court order + school enrollment + agency placement letter. That should be enough for provisional enrollment. Make sure the school form includes the child's name and address.
Tomas B.: Great. I need coverage retroactive to the date I assumed guardianship (two weeks ago). Is that possible?
Ken L.: Payroll/retro note: We can request retro coverage to the QLE date when carriers accept the docs. If accepted, premiums will be prorated and adjustments processed on the next payroll cycle. If carrier denies retro effective date, coverage may be set to carriers acceptance date.
Tomas B.: Any hurry on the docs? Court told me final paperwork may take 30-45 days.
Benefits Admin: Upload the emergency order now and the school/agency docs when available. We can provisionally enroll for up to 60 days pending final guardianship decree. If final decree is delayed, we can request an extension with the carrier if you provide a processing receipt or docket entry showing pending status.
Tomas B.: Is there a secure upload? Not comfortable sending PHI over email.
people-ops-bot: Secure upload link created: https://benefits.redwood.com/secure-upload/TB-1901234567 (expires in 14 days).
Lina (People Ops): In the upload form choose "Qualifying Life Event - Dependent Addition (temporary guardianship)" and in notes add the QLE date (date you assumed guardianship) and expected timeline for final decree.
Tomas B.: If provisional coverage is allowed, can I also enroll her in our employer-sponsored dental and vision?
Evie R.: Yes, enroll in all plans youre eligible for during the QLE flow in the portal. Some carriers have different doc policies for dental/vision; we'll flag those if they request additional paperwork.
Tomas B.: Will claims be paid during provisional period? I have an upcoming pediatric visit next week.
Benefits Admin: Most carriers process claims during provisional coverage but may require final verification. If the carrier later determines the documentation is insufficient, they might reverse payments; that's uncommon but possible. We recommend keeping receipts and notifying us if any claims are urgent so we can prioritize verification.
Tomas B.: OK I'll upload the emergency order now and the agency letter later today.
people-ops-bot: Case created: PO-8033 - Temporary guardianship dependent add. Benefits admin notified.
Ken L.: I'll monitor payroll to apply any retro proration once benefits confirms. Tag me on the case if you want a faster payroll adjustment.
Tomas B.: Thanks all. Appreciate the quick responses.
